caveats: Every watercourse feature is a single undifferentiated class: DESCRIPTIVE_TERM is a space and FEATURE_CODE is 9013001 throughout. The layer does NOT distinguish river from stream from drain, and does not carry a name. You cannot tell the River Dhoo from a field drain using this data.
Cross-reference the Field Gazetteer for watercourse names.
